expectations.text: separate-files: Component uses separate .html and .scss files (templateUrl/styleUrl), never inline template/styles
expectations.evidence: Component uses templateUrl: './form-input.component.html' and styleUrl: './form-input.component.scss' in the @Component decorator (lines 20-21 of .ts file).
changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush is set in the @Component decorator (line 22 of .ts file).

expectations.text: no-services: Dumb component has zero injected services (no constructor DI or inject())
expectations.evidence: No constructor defined and no inject() calls anywhere in the component. Only @Input/@Output decorators and local logic.

expectations.text: rhythm-spacing: SCSS uses unigrid spacing tokens (--ug-spacing-*) or leading-based calc() for margins/padding
expectations.evidence: SCSS uses --ug-spacing-3 for host margin-bottom (line 12), --ug-spacing-1 for form-text margin-top (line 99), and --ug-leading for line-height (line 24).

expectations.text: touch-target: Input has minimum 44px touch target (min-height: 44px or equivalent)
expectations.evidence: SCSS sets min-height: 44px and min-width: 44px on .form-control (lines 20-21 of .scss file).

expectations.text: focus-visible: Includes :focus-visible styles with visible OUTLINE (not just box-shadow or color change)
expectations.evidence: SCSS has &:focus-visible with outline: 3px solid var(--ui-focus-color, #1a73e8) and outline-offset: 2px (lines 36-41). box-shadow is explicitly set to none.

expectations.text: aria-invalid: Uses aria-invalid and aria-describedby for error states
expectations.evidence: HTML template uses [attr.aria-invalid]="state === 'error' ? true : null" (line 14) and [attr.aria-describedby]="ariaDescribedBy" (line 17). The ariaDescribedBy getter links to feedbackId when in error state.

expectations.text: reduced-motion: Animations/transitions wrapped in prefers-reduced-motion media query
expectations.evidence: SCSS includes @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .form-floating .form-control { transition: none; } } at lines 109-113.

expectations.text: mobile-first: SCSS uses min-width media queries (mobile-first), not max-width
expectations.evidence: The component SCSS itself has no media queries for breakpoints (only prefers-reduced-motion and forced-colors). The mockup HTML uses min-width media queries (min-width: 768px, min-width: 1024px). No max-width queries found anywhere. The component is inherently mobile-first as it uses display: block with no breakpoint-specific overrides.

expectations.text: storybook-variants: Storybook stories include at least: Default, Error, Success, Disabled variants
expectations.evidence: Stories file exports: Default (line 65), ErrorState (line 106), SuccessState (line 116), and Disabled (line 129) story variants.

expectations.text: bootstrap-integration: Uses Bootstrap classes (form-floating, form-control, is-invalid, is-valid) in the HTML template
expectations.evidence: HTML template uses form-floating (line 2), form-control (line 3), is-invalid via [class.is-invalid] (line 5), is-valid via [class.is-valid] (line 6), invalid-feedback (line 33), valid-feedback (line 44), and form-text (line 52).

expectations.text: html-mockup: Includes a standalone HTML mockup file demonstrating all states visually
expectations.evidence: form-input-mockup.html exists as a standalone HTML file with Bootstrap CDN, demonstrates all states: input types (text/email/tel/number), validation states (default/error/success), disabled, required, focus, help text, and responsive layout.
